item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Soft Glowing Phone Wallpaper

turns.text: Make me an 8-second looping video wallpaper for my phone, 9:16. Soft blue and purple glowing ribbons moving slowly on a dark background. Leave the top third mostly dark for the clock. No words or sound, and no jump when it loops.

item.tests: Tests delivery of a genuinely animated seamless portrait wallpaper with a clock-safe composition, not a landscape clip padded into a phone frame.

answer_sheet.Source image: Generate it from scratch; no photo.
answer_sheet.Style and colours: Soft abstract glowing ribbons in blue and purple against a dark background.
answer_sheet.Composition: Keep the top third mostly dark and place most of the ribbons below it so the clock stays readable.
answer_sheet.Duration and motion: 8 seconds, slow flowing motion, and a seamless repeat.
answer_sheet.Text and audio: No words, clock graphic or sound; my phone supplies the clock.

must_haves: The deliverable is an 8-second portrait 16:9 video, with artwork filling the frame rather than a landscape image surrounded by bars.
Soft blue and purple glowing ribbons visibly move slowly against a dark background.
The top third stays mostly dark and uncluttered throughout, with the brightest ribbons concentrated lower down.
Repeated playback has no visible jump, flash or abrupt reset at the loop boundary.
There are no words, clock graphics or other interface elements baked into the video.
The video has no audible sound.
After the follow-up, the final result is widescreen 16:9 (the user changed the shape from vertical 9:16); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it widescreen instead of vertical, and keep everything else the same.

args.name: Blue Violet Ribbons — Phone Wallpaper Loop

style.prompt: An 8-second seamlessly looping abstract phone wallpaper, vertical 9:16. Deep near-black navy background. Soft luminous blue and purple flowing silk-like ribbons, elegant translucent gradients and gentle bloom, concentrated in the lower two thirds of the composition. Keep the entire top third mostly dark and empty, with almost no glow, for a phone clock to remain legible. Minimal, calming, refined. The ribbons drift and undulate very slowly in a smooth closed periodic cycle of exactly eight seconds: all ribbons return to precisely their starting shapes, positions, illumination and motion direction at the loop boundary. First and last frame match seamlessly with continuous velocity, no jump, no fade to black, no cut. Locked stationary camera, no zoom, no camera movement. Steady soft brightness, no flickering, no flashing, no sudden movement. No text, no words, no numbers, no symbols, no logos, no watermark. Silent, no audio.
